articles.summary: To help Snapchatters revisit their favorite Memories from 2025, today, we’re dropping this year’s Snapchat Recap.

articles.summary: We’re introducing Quick Cut, our Lens-powered video creation tool that helps Snapchatters turn their favorite Memories into beat-synced, ready-to-share videos in seconds.
articles.title: In-App Editing for All: Snapchat Introduces Quick Cut

articles.summary: Today, we’re offering a new way for you to take your creativity to an entirely new dimension with our first open prompt video generation Lens: Animate It.
articles.title: Introducing Animate It, a New Way to Create Personalized Videos From Any Prompt

articles.summary: Snapchat’s Winter Village invites you into three luxury worlds—Chopard, BOSS, and Lancôme—reimagined in augmented reality for the holidays. Discover, explore, and shop your favorite brands in an immersive AR village live on Snapchat all December long.
articles.title: Snapchat Winter Village
